description: Charred, sweet and savory with a tender interior, this is about as good as salmon gets.

ingredients.prep: at least 1 inch thick, 5 to 6 ounces each
ingredients.raw: 4 skinless salmon fillet, at least 1 inch thick, 5 to 6 ounces each

brief: Whisk miso, sake, soy sauce, oil, and sugar.
Rub mixture over {{4}} skinless salmon fillets.
Transfer to a bag or container and marinate if desired.
steps.text: Whisk together {{1/4 cup}} of red or white miso, {{1/3 cup}} of sake, {{1 tablespoon}} of soy sauce, {{2 tablespoons}} of vegetable oil, and {{1/4 cup}} of sugar. Rub mixture over every surface of {{4}} skinless salmon fillets. Transfer to a plastic zipper lock bag or sealable container. Proceed immediately to next step, or for best results, marinate for about 30 minutes or up to 2 days.

brief: Preheat broiler to high and line a broiler pan with foil.
Rub excess marinade off salmon and place on pan.
Broil for about 5 minutes until charred and warm in center.
steps.text: Preheat a broiler (toaster oven or regular oven) to high. Cover a small broiler pan with aluminum foil. Rub excess marinade off of salmon and place on broiler pan. Broil until top surface is well charred and salmon is barely warm in the center, about 5 minutes, using the foil to protect any areas that threaten to burn. Serve immediately.

title: 5-Minute Miso Glazed Salmon
